properties.description: D2h rectangular singlet ground-state minimum of cyclobutadiene (bond-alternating ring), GFN2-xTB, gas phase, charge 0, multiplicity 1
D4h square first-order saddle; single imaginary mode is the in-plane b1g ring bond-alternation coordinate
rectangular minimum with cyclically permuted ring-atom labels (bond-shifted degenerate product)

edges.name: automerization
edges.channel: automerization (degenerate ring bond-order reversal through the D4h square saddle)

properties.barrier_definition: dE(double dagger) = E(TS) - E(reactant) = 0.035858642666 Ha = 22.50 kcal/mol; electronic energy only, without ZPE or thermal correction
properties.direction_proof: documented substitute for IRC: the converged saddle was displaced by +/-0.15 A along the Cartesian imaginary-mode direction and both frames were reoptimized with native xtb --ohess (0 imaginary frequencies, opt converged, equal endpoint energies, mass-weighted eigenvector/endpoint overlap +0.978/-0.978). Not an IRC.
properties.short_irc_status: open gap: no IRC-capable engine under the xtb-only MethodPolicy (xtb 6.5.0 has no IRC; ts_prepare rejects ts_opt for engine xtb); the four-bond concerted scan is unreachable (ChemTask caps scan coordinates at 2; plain xtb jobs drop a hand-written xcontrol). Documented limitation, not waived.
properties.method_caveat: GFN2-xTB semiempirical value; the method overestimates this antiaromatic square saddle relative to correlated results.
